column1: # by research/submorph/curate.py; hand rows appended. Schema:
# Curation rule for meaning fragments (Phase 143, applied by hand): the
# fragment must carry its gloss to an English ear. "cel" earns excel, "tain"
# earns obtain — but "lot" never meant ocelot, "gon" never meant argon, and
# "per" means neither perky nor copper. About a hundred mined rows of that
# kind were removed, because the decode shown on the card would be a lie.
# The judgment is deliberately not a runtime rule: every mechanical version
# of it either kept "per" or threw out "cel", the family's own exemplar.
# Fragments that failed only as tails (breez, cer, fer, jaz, mer, smal) stay
# as heads, with their associations trimmed to the words they open.
